name: AI事業変革シミュレーター
description:
A Japanese-language service. The interface and all generated output are in Japanese.

The simulator reframes a business along three axes — who you serve, what you offer, and how you deliver it — and proposes new business ideas, each with an estimated probability of success and the reasoning behind that estimate.

Adding this connector lets you run an analysis directly from a conversation with Claude, and pull up analyses you ran earlier on the web.

What you can do
- Run an analysis: give the three axes and receive five business ideas with success probabilities. Claude first shows you what it is about to analyse and how much of your allowance it will use, and runs it only after you agree.
- Browse your history: list past analyses and open any one of them.
- Read the detailed analyses attached to an idea: SWOT, competitor analysis, persona, customer journey, action plan and more.
- Check your usage: analyses run so far, your plan's limit, and what remains.

Only the signed-in account can see its own data. The read-only tools never consume your analysis allowance; only running a new analysis does.

──────────

「誰に・何を・どのように」の3つの軸で事業を捉え直し、新しい事業案を成功確率つきで提示するサービスです。このコネクタを追加すると、Claude との会話からそのまま分析を実行したり、過去の分析結果を呼び出したりできます。

できること
・事業分析の実行（5案を成功確率つきで生成。実行前に内容と消費回数を確認します）
・分析履歴の一覧と、個別の分析結果の閲覧
・特徴分析の閲覧（SWOT・競合分析・ペルソナ・カスタマージャーニー・アクションプラン等）
・使用状況の確認（実行回数・プラン上限・残り回数）

参照系のツールは分析回数を消費しません。消費するのは分析の実行だけです。

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AI事業変革シミュレーター to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector.
